answer_1.quote: Targeted to automatic multi-product AD post generation, we propose a two-stage model named S-MG Net.
datasets: Multi-product AD post dataset from Bimai Qingdan in Taobao
answer_1.outputs: Generated advertising copy for each product in a multi-product AD post.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the results of the generated AD post, we adopt the following widely used metrics. Embedding Metrics. To obtain semantic matches between the generated copywriting and ground-truth, we perform evaluation using the embedding metrics. Following , we calculate three measures: 1) Average, cosine similarity between the averaged word embeddings in the two utterances ; 2) Greedy, i.e., greedily matching words in two utterances based on the cosine similarities, and the total scores are then averaged across all words ; 3) Extrema, cosine similarity between the largest values among the word embeddings in the two utterances . ... Distinct Metrics. We use distinct scores to reflect the diversity of the copywriting.

answer_4.quote: Because Tao et al. (2018b) mentioned that only using the automatic metrics to evaluate text quality can be misleading, we also conduct human evaluation. Three well-educated annotators are hired to evaluate the quality of generation, where the evaluation is conducted in a double-blind fashion.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated on four aspects: readability, informativeness, attractiveness, and rationality, each scored from 1 to 4, as detailed in Table 1.
